Friends
922 - The one with the donor

Written by: Andrew Reich & Ted Cohen
Directed by: Ben Weiss
Transcribed by: Eleonora, Pheeboh, Sebastiano & Vanessa

[Scene: Central Perk. Charlie, Joey and Rachel are on the couches]

Charlie: (while Joey's giving her a massage) Oh!
（乔伊正在给她按摩）哦！ That feels sooo good!
那种感觉真好！

咖啡和现场性爱表演！

Charlie: I'm sorry, what?
对不起，什么？

Rachel: Oh...
哦... Oh, I'm sorry!
哦，对不起！ I'm not...
我不是... I was just-I was just reading to Emma.
我只是——我只是在给艾玛读书。

Charlie: From...
从... Cosmo??
科斯莫？？

Rachel: Yeah, yeah...
是啊是啊... It's...
它是... "climax your way to better skin".
“多享高潮，肌肤更好”。

Charlie: (to Joey) So, I have to go shopping today, which is my least favourite thing, I'm soo bad at picking out clothes!

Joey: So you need someone who knows fashion, to tell you what looks good.

Rachel: Yeah...
是的...

那好吧...

你在开玩笑吧？ Rachel loves to shop!

而且她很有品味！ Yeah, she's the one who taught me, you don't wear white after labour day and that you always, always, always have to put on underwear when you're trying on clothes.
是的，她是那个教我的人，劳动节后不要穿白色衣服，而且当你试穿衣服时，你总是、总是、总是必须穿上内衣。

Phoebe: (entering and talking on mobile phone) Ok, great!
（进入并用手机通话）好的，太好了！ All right, bye!
好吧，再见！ (she hangs up) Pain in the ass!!

（她看看其他人，然后又看向电话）那已经结束了，对吧？

Phoebe: Oh...
哦... Mike's sister just invited me to a party tonight, he's gonna be there.
迈克的姐姐刚刚邀请我参加今晚的一个聚会，他会去的。 And she was like "Oh, don't worry!
她就像“哦，别担心！ I asked him.
我问他。 He's totally ok with seeing you!".
他很高兴见到你！” So now I have to go so he'll think that I'm totally ok with seeing him!
所以现在我必须走了，这样他就会认为我完全同意见到他！

Opening credits

[Scene: Doctor Connelly's office]

Chandler: (looking at the picture of the female reproductive system) Wow!

Chandler: Oh, I can't believe my sperm have low motility because, let me tell you, when I was growing up they sure seem to be in a hurry to get places!!

（进入）你好。

Chandler: Hi.
你好。

Monica: Hi.
你好。

很抱歉您上周的测试没有带来更好的消息，但我想和您谈谈您的选择。

Monica: Ok.
好的。

Doctor Connelly: Above all, even though your chances of conceiving through natural means aren't great, you never know!

哦，该死！

(Dr. Connelly glares at Chandler)

没关系，过一阵他就会学会当没听见了。

Doctor Connelly: Ok, given your situation, the options with the greatest chances for success would be surrogacy, or insemination using a sperm donor.
好的，考虑到您的情况，成功机会最大的选择是代孕或使用精子捐赠者授精。

Monica: (long pause) Ok.
（长时间停顿）好的。

Doctor Connelly: And, of course, if you feel that neither of those is right for you, you can always adopt.
如果这两种方式都不合适，你们当然还可以领养孩子。

Chandler: Is that a hint?
这是一个暗示吗？ Because we love you Doctor Connelly but we don't think we'd want you to be our child!
因为我们爱你康纳利医生，但我们不希望你成为我们的孩子！ (Dr. Connelly glares at him) Wow, talking about an inhospitable environment!
（康纳利博士瞪着他）哇，谈论的是一个不适宜居住的环境！

[Scene: Central Perk. Joey and Charlie on the couch. Rachel enters]

Rachel: Hi!
你好！ Ok, you're ready to go pick up Phoebe and go shopping?

Ross: (entering) Hey, you guys!
（进来）嘿，你们！

Rachel: Hi.
你好。

Ross: Guess who's up for keynote speaker at the National Paleontology Conference?

Charlie: Umh...
嗯... Kurts Baley?
库尔茨·贝利？

Ross: Yeah, right!
是啊，对！ What was last time he met a submission deadline for an abstract (he and Charlie laugh, then Joey starts laughing too without any reason) Well, why are you laughing?
他上次在摘要提交截止日期之前是什么时候了（他和查理笑了，然后乔伊也无缘无故地笑了）那么，你为什么笑？

Joey: Just...
只是... seeing what it'd be like to be a paleontologist...
看看成为一名古生物学家会是什么样子...... it's fun, yeah!

他是一个很难给人留下深刻印象的人。

Ross: Yeah, well...
是啊，嗯…… I think I know how to dazzle him.
我想我知道如何让他眼花缭乱。

Rachel: Oh...
哦... you're not gonna do a magic trick, are ya?
你不会变魔术吧？

慈... NO!
不！ (he goes to sit down, dropping a multicoloured silk streamer off his sleeve).
（他坐下来，从袖子上掉下一条彩色丝带）。

Chandler: (entering) Hey guys!
（进来）嘿伙计们！

Ross: Wait a minute, you guys.
等一下，你们。 Oh, I wanna ask you something.
哦，我想问你一件事。 I-I I may get to speak at this paleontology convention and if I do, I'd love for you guys to come and hear me.
我-我可能会在这次古生物学大会上发言，如果我这样做，我希望你们能来听我的演讲。

Chandler: I think I can safely say that we all have family issues, work stuff and/or are sick.
我想我可以有把握地说，我们都有家庭问题、工作问题和/或生病。

Ross: It's in Barbados.
这是在巴巴多斯。

不过你当然是第一位的！

Rachel: I'm there!
我去！

Charlie: We'll see you, guys!
我们会再见，伙计们！ (she goes)

再见。

Rachel: Bye, see ya.

Joey: All right, so.

在生育诊所进行得怎么样？

没有上次那么有趣。 Apparently you only get porn if you're giving a sperm sample.
显然，只有提供精子样本才能看到色情内容。

Ross: So-so what did the doctor say?

Chandler: Well...

对她来说太难了。

Joey: So you're ruling out surrogacy?
所以你排除代孕的可能吗？

Chandler: Yeah.
是的。

那么，我不必了解这意味着什么？

我们正在谈论精子捐赠者。

说得够多了，我就在你身边。 Where is she, upstairs?
她在哪儿，楼上？

来吧，罗斯，做一个好人。 Step up and do it!
站起来去做吧！

(Joey moves close to Ross and whispers something in his ear)

Ross: (looking astonished) What?
（一脸惊讶）什么？ NO!

[Scene: Professor Sherman's office, Ross is relating to Professor Sherman]

Ross: The data we are receiving from MRI scans and DNA testing of these fossils are - are staggering.
我们从这些化石的 MRI 扫描和 DNA 测试中收到的数据令人震惊。

Professor Sherman: Mmm-mm.
嗯嗯。

Ross: (reading from a notepad) I mean, we've been accepting Leakey's dates as a given, but if they're off by even a hundred thousand years or so then you can - you can just throw most of our assumptions, you know, right in the trash.
（从记事本上读）我的意思是，我们一直接受利基的日期作为给定的，但如果它们甚至相差十万年左右，那么你就可以 - 你知道，你可以把我们的大部分假设扔进垃圾桶。 (he throws the notepad in the waste bin) So-so what I am saying is - is is that (he picks the notepad back from the waste bin) is that the repercussions could be huge!
（他把记事本扔进垃圾桶）一般般，我想说的是——是（他从垃圾桶里捡起记事本）后果可能是巨大的！ I mean, not just in palaeontology, but if-if you think about it, in evolutionary biology, uh, genetics, geology, uh, I mean, truly the mind boggles!

(Turns to look at Professor Sherman, only to discover that he is sleeping)

看，我告诉过你我需要一个人！ Oh, you know, by the way, as a "thank you", I would really love to take you out.

是的！ I'm a big fan!

她就那么聪明又高挑地走进来…… You know, and just swept Joey off his feet...
你知道，而且刚刚让乔伊神魂颠倒…… I mean, nobody else has a chance!

任何人！ You, me, you know, Monica's mom...
你，我，你知道，莫妮卡的妈妈......

你喜欢乔伊？

嘘！ Phoebe!
菲比！ All right, look.

查理有可能有一个聋哑双胞胎吗？

[Scene: Monica's apartment, Chandler walks in with a friend of his while Monica is putting fruit in a bowl.]

嗨亲爱的！

Chandler: Hey!
嘿！ Look I brought a friend for dinner, this is Zack, from work!
看，我带了一个朋友来吃晚饭，这是扎克，下班了！

我的意思是，看，他很聪明，他很健康，他很有运动能力，我的意思是，他“精子活力十足”！

钱德勒，这太疯狂了！ What did you even say to him!

不，我请他吃饭，这样你就有机会认识他了！ I mean, if we go through a sperm bank you never meet the guy, get to check him out.
我的意思是，如果我们去精子库，你永远不会见到那个人，去检查一下他。

Monica: Chandler!
钱德勒！

我的意思是，即使我的精子运作良好，我也认为他会是我的出路！

你不能随便带一个人回家并指望他成为我们的精子捐赠者！

Chandler: Ok!
好的！

Monica: Uh!
呃！

Chandler: (bringing the beer to Zack) Zack!

谢谢！ Do you have a coaster?
你有杯垫吗？ I don't wanna make a ring.
我不想在桌上留下水印。

告诉我你自己吧，扎克！
